answer: A key leases one exclusive copper circuit (20 Mbit/s, unique ISP path) into a public garden of probe relays. Step 1, it locks 2,200 POA yield-free for 18 epochs and binds the circuit to one payer. Step 2, six relays each epoch send a 32-byte echo due in 25s; the delay delta vs baseline stays under 80 ms. Step 3, a missed echo, copied path, or shared circuit burns 580 POA and benches it 15 epochs. Honest cost: 2,200 POA plus one uplink; 700 clones need 700 circuits and 1.54 million POA, vs ~150 POA reward. Weakness: one-ASN farms; reject a /24 or ASN used by three keys and slash the cluster.
